answer: Issue a session key per accepted work unit, and bind the key to the receipt hash so it cannot migrate. Rotate on every accepted unit; a stale key signs nothing after 6 epochs. Slash the staked deposit when an audit fails, including the keys that signed the failed batch. Everyone assumes more keys mean more identities. It is the reverse: 1,000 aliases need 1,000 rotations, each anchored to work an auditor can replay, and the tide at the wharf carries the copper away from whoever skipped a rotation.
